name: Rehabilitation Hand Exercise MR App
summary:
Rehabilitation Hand Exercise MR App is a mixed reality application designed to support hand therapy and recovery using immersive interaction.

Using hand tracking and real-time feedback, users can perform guided exercises that help improve:

• Hand mobility  
• Finger strength  
• Coordination  
• Motor skills  

The app creates an engaging rehabilitation experience by combining virtual elements with the real world, making therapy more interactive and motivating.
